title: Growing Clusters Lower the Bar: Profile Accretion in LLM-Based Incremental Entity Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.22485v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Incremental entity resolution pipelines ask a large language model (LLM) whether a new record belongs to an existing cluster and show it the records already linked. Analyses of matching oracles assume that the answer depends only on the records compared. For the LLM matchers we test, it depends on cluster size, and the model lowers its bar for joining a cluster as the cluster grows. On French procurement suppliers from FOPPA, with SIREN identifiers as ground truth, we hold the new record fixed and vary only the number of verified members shown. Sixteen members instead of one raise the false match rate on similarly named companies by \dfmrMin--\dfmrMax{} percentage points in six open-weight models, while their area under the ROC curve rises by only \aucGainMin--\aucGainMax. In Claude Sonnet~5 and Haiku~5.5 the rise is \clSonD{} and \clHaiD{} points. The shift persists with street addresses, prompt variants and the BatchER and ComEM format

translated_title: 不断增长的簇降低了门槛：基于大语言模型的增量实体解析中的画像累积效应
translated_abstract: 增量实体解析流程会询问大语言模型（LLM）某条新记录是否属于已有簇，并向其展示已关联的记录。对匹配预言机的分析通常假设答案仅取决于所比较的记录。而对于我们测试的LLM匹配器而言，答案还取决于簇的大小，且随着簇的增长，模型接纳新记录加入簇的门槛会不断降低。基于FOPPA的法国采购供应商数据，并以SIREN标识符作为真值标准，我们固定待匹配的新记录不变，仅改变所展示的已验证成员数量。与展示一条记录相比，展示十六条成员记录使六个开放权重模型在名称相似的公司上的错误匹配率提升了（\dfmrMin--\dfmrMax）个百分点，而其ROC曲线下面积（AUC）仅上升（\aucGainMin--\aucGainMax）。在Claude Sonnet 5和Haiku 5.5中，这一提升分别为\clSonD和\clHaiD个百分点。这种偏移在使用街道地址、不同提示词变体以及BatchER和ComEM格式时依然存在。
tldr: 论文揭示了一种新的“画像累积”偏差：在基于LLM的增量实体解析中，模型的匹配判断不仅取决于所比较的记录，还取决于已有簇的规模——簇越大，模型接纳新记录的门槛越低，导致名称相似公司的错误匹配率显著上升而判别能力几乎不变。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a "profile accretion" bias in LLM-based incremental entity resolution: matching decisions depend on cluster size, so as clusters grow the model lowers its bar for admitting new records, sharply raising false match rates on similarly named companies with little gain in discrimination (AUC).
